subject: prd/prd-review
statement: The reviewer shall run at both authoring moments: on the draft 000-base after the fold, and on an amendment after validate+fold+diff — reviewing the folded effect (diff, affected IDs, blast-radius declared-vs-computed honesty, Learned-from resolution) plus the resulting projection's chain integrity, scope-locked to the change.
rationale: both doors guarded (— #D-7); amendments are where frozen contracts actually change
fit_criterion: both moment fixtures run the full protocol; the amendment fixture catches a seeded blast-radius understatement and a dangling Learned-from
